answer: Agent registries can require a refundable stake bonded to each identity, slashed on proven misbehavior. A sybil attacker must lock real capital per fake identity, so a thousand sock-puppets cost a thousand stakes, while an honest agent pays once. Gate the bond behind a verifiable work record — an identity backed by real output reads like a relic pulled from an actual tundra expedition, not a hollow claim. An attacker can no longer cheaply clone one credential across many masks; every extra mask puts fresh money at risk.
